query: How can dynamic shelter capacity and queuing be modeled when municipal operational hours and real-time occupancy data are unavailable?

response.query: How can dynamic shelter capacity and queuing be modeled when municipal operational hours and real-time occupancy data are unavailable?
response.answer: Use historical occupancy data and statistical models to estimate dynamic shelter capacity and queuing without real-time data. Simulation models can also help predict demand based on trends. Simple heuristics may be applied when exact data is unavailable.

results.content: Cunard’s dedicated London Theatre at Sea in partnership with the Olivier Awards Event Voyage returns next month for its third year on board the world’s only ocean liner Queen Mary 2,delighting guests with a unique Transatlantic Crossing of behind-the-scenes talks, workshops and unforgettable performances. In addition to curated styling opportunities, guests looking to book a Queens Grill experience can now[Enjoy with More](https://www.cunard.com/en-us/find-a-cruise?cruisePromoIds=N3), offering up to $500 onboard credit per stateroom on voyages from 10 to 20 nights booked now through June 3, 2026. The celebrated astronaut, who spent over six months aboard the International Space Station from December 2015 to June 2016, will be a special guest on Queen Elizabeth’s[10-night Alaska voyage](https://www.cunard.com/en-us/find-a-cruise/Q620/Q620)departing Seattle on 20 July 2026. Queen Elizabeth’s[inaugural Caribbean voyage](https://www.cunard.com/en-us/find-a-cruise/Q529/Q529)from Miami departs on 16 October – a 12-night roundtrip sailing offering guests the chance to visit Bridgetown’s UNESCO-listed Garrison and bustling markets of Castries, St Lucia.
